Because in a legacy system, software usually waits for a human to initiate an action. Someone has to open an inbox, read an email, and click a button to start a process. Exactly.

Yes. It instantly wakes up the AI to trigger the next sequential step in the process without any human initiation. And the entity that responds to that flare gun is the second building block.
